positive_cases: A new reusable skill has a complete provider-neutral card and passes the protected gate.
negative_cases: A new reusable identity has no disposition.
A portable core encodes a permanent provider or model binding.
A receipt is replayed or lacks verified model identity.
failure_recovery_cases: Policy or baseline digest mismatch fails closed.
Unavailable runtime evidence returns no_winner without changing the active route.
Unsafe rollback produces a resumable checkpoint.
rollback: Deactivate the reviewed policy pointer and revert the bounded revision; preserve immutable evidence and revalidate before restoration.
